notes.title: L33na – A New Game Coming Soon. Wishlist it now!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone! After two years without releasing a new game, we’re thrilled to announce the launch of [i]L33na Redpepper[/i], our newest project and a big step forward for our studio.[/p][p]Our previous games were made using much older versions of Unity, which limited what we could achieve. Now, with [i]L33na[/i], we’re exploring modern Unity features like URP and HDRP, and writing much cleaner, more efficient code. We’re tackling two major priorities: improving FPS while delivering better visual quality, and minimizing bugs for a smoother experience.[/p][p]While we focused on refining this new project, much of the technology and features we’re developing for [i]L33na[/i] will also help us enhance some of our older games in the future.[/p][p]For those who have supported us since the beginning, we have a special surprise waiting — check it out on the game page![/p][p][/p][p]We’re excited to share this new chapter with you and hope you enjoy the journey as much as we do![/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805390/L33na_Redpepper/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1ST BIG F()CK4JOY UPDATE
notes.notes:
A new update is available for fuck4joy. Two more levels were created and some problems that persisted in the previous version were fixed.
The game continues with improvements, and we count on your help.
Orgipix Studios underwent structural changes and we now have a programmer and a designer. Both are great. Aolah still works with us. However, she is developing her own games.
Don't worry because the other games are already well advanced and will be re-released.

This is the first one we're releasing. Next up is Pornocrates Osiris's Seed (which has a serious FPS issue).
We are also finishing Hardpunch Sex Plague and all other games.
